free_tier.stated: $2.50/TiB/month per copy, plus $0.12 per data-set/month proving fee. 20 TiB = $50/mo per copy; two copies = $100/mo

egress.terms: CDN egress 'up to $14/TiB (about $0.014/GiB) downloaded' via Filecoin Beam, about half that from cache. 1 TiB/day = 30 TiB/mo = up to $420/mo

interface_detail: Synapse SDK; FWSS (Filecoin Warm Storage Service); Filecoin Pay streaming payments
tooling: synapse-sdk, USDFC deposits, lotus/curio on the provider side
limits_note: Storage at $2.50/TiB is genuinely competitive, but total cost of ownership for a user is dominated by egress: $420/mo of CDN to serve 1 TiB/day on top of $100/mo of storage = $520/mo. Also gated on holding USDFC (a stablecoin) and a refundable ~$0.50 lifecycle reserve per data set; each add-pieces call costs $0.008 + $0.003/piece, which is punitive for a 20 TiB corpus of many small objects.
reliability_note: Requires a funded stablecoin wallet; deals are 30-day-epoch denominated and stream payments continuously.

evidence.proved: pricing table: 'Storage $2.50/TiB/month per copy'; 'Proving Service $0.12/data set/month'; 'CDN egress up to $14/TiB (≈ $0.014/GiB) downloaded'; 'Add pieces $0.008 + $0.003 per piece'
'No CDN ~0.50 USDFC (lifecycle reserve lockup)' minimum to create a data set
verified deals required allocator approval and DataCap (now historical)
